148    /** {@inheritDoc} */
149    @Override
150    public void initialize( final Engine engine, final Properties props ) throws NoRequiredPropertyException, IOException {
151        m_engine = engine;
152        searchExecutor = Executors.newCachedThreadPool();
153
154        m_luceneDirectory = engine.getWorkDir() + File.separator + LUCENE_DIR;
155
156        final int initialDelay = TextUtil.getIntegerProperty( props, PROP_LUCENE_INITIALDELAY, LuceneUpdater.INITIAL_DELAY );
157        final int indexDelay   = TextUtil.getIntegerProperty( props, PROP_LUCENE_INDEXDELAY, LuceneUpdater.INDEX_DELAY );
158
159        m_analyzerClass = TextUtil.getStringProperty( props, PROP_LUCENE_ANALYZER, m_analyzerClass );
160        // FIXME: Just to be simple for now, we will do full reindex only if no files are in lucene directory.
161
162        final File dir = new File( m_luceneDirectory );
163        LOG.info( "Lucene enabled, cache will be in: {}", dir.getAbsolutePath() );
164        try {
165            if( !dir.exists() ) {
166                dir.mkdirs();
167            }
168
169            if( !dir.exists() || !dir.canWrite() || !dir.canRead() ) {
170                LOG.error( "Cannot write to Lucene directory, disabling Lucene: {}", dir.getAbsolutePath() );
171                throw new IOException( "Invalid Lucene directory." );
172            }
173
174            final String[] filelist = dir.list();
175            if( filelist == null ) {
176                throw new IOException( "Invalid Lucene directory: cannot produce listing: " + dir.getAbsolutePath() );
177            }
178        } catch( final IOException e ) {
179            LOG.error( "Problem while creating Lucene index - not using Lucene.", e );
180        }
181
182        // Start the Lucene update thread, which waits first for a little while before starting to go through
183        // the Lucene "pages that need updating".
184        final LuceneUpdater updater = new LuceneUpdater( m_engine, this, initialDelay, indexDelay );
185        updater.start();
186    }

197    /**
198     * Performs a full Lucene reindex, if necessary.
199     *
200     * @throws IOException If there's a problem during indexing
201     */
202    protected void doFullLuceneReindex() throws IOException {
203        final File dir = new File( m_luceneDirectory );
204        final String[] filelist = dir.list();
205        if( filelist == null ) {
206            throw new IOException( "Invalid Lucene directory: cannot produce listing: " + dir.getAbsolutePath() );
207        }
208
209        try {
210            if( filelist.length == 0 ) {
211                //
212                //  No files? Reindex!
213                //
214                final Date start = new Date();
215
216                LOG.info( "Starting Lucene reindexing, this can take a couple of minutes..." );
217
218                final Directory luceneDir = new NIOFSDirectory( dir.toPath() );
219                try( final IndexWriter writer = getIndexWriter( luceneDir ) ) {
220                    long pagesIndexed = 0L;
221                    final Collection< Page > allPages = m_engine.getManager( PageManager.class ).getAllPages();
222                    for( final Page page : allPages ) {
223                        try {
224                            final String text = m_engine.getManager( PageManager.class ).getPageText( page.getName(), WikiProvider.LATEST_VERSION );
225                            luceneIndexPage( page, text, writer );
226                            pagesIndexed++;
227                        } catch( final IOException e ) {
228                            LOG.warn( "Unable to index page {}, continuing to next ", page.getName(), e );
229                        }
230                    }
231                    LOG.info( "Indexed {} pages", pagesIndexed );
232
233                    long attachmentsIndexed = 0L;
234                    final Collection< Attachment > allAttachments = m_engine.getManager( AttachmentManager.class ).getAllAttachments();
235                    for( final Attachment att : allAttachments ) {
236                        try {
237                            final String text = getAttachmentContent( att.getName(), WikiProvider.LATEST_VERSION );
238                            luceneIndexPage( att, text, writer );
239                            attachmentsIndexed++;
240                        } catch( final IOException e ) {
241                            LOG.warn( "Unable to index attachment {}, continuing to next", att.getName(), e );
242                        }
243                    }
244                    LOG.info( "Indexed {} attachments", attachmentsIndexed );
245                }
246
247                final Date end = new Date();
248                LOG.info( "Full Lucene index finished in {} milliseconds.", end.getTime() - start.getTime() );
249            } else {
250                LOG.info( "Files found in Lucene directory, not reindexing." );
251            }
252        } catch( final IOException e ) {
253            LOG.error( "Problem while creating Lucene index - not using Lucene.", e );
254        } catch( final ProviderException e ) {
255            LOG.error( "Problem reading pages while creating Lucene index (JSPWiki won't start.)", e );
256            throw new IllegalArgumentException( "unable to create Lucene index" );
257        } catch( final Exception e ) {
258            LOG.error( "Unable to start lucene", e );
259        }
260
261    }
262
263    /**
264     * Fetches the attachment content from the repository.
265     * Content is flat text that can be used for indexing/searching or display
266     *
267     * @param attachmentName Name of the attachment.
268     * @param version        The version of the attachment.
269     * @return the content of the Attachment as a String.
270     */
271    protected String getAttachmentContent( final String attachmentName, final int version ) {
272        final AttachmentManager mgr = m_engine.getManager( AttachmentManager.class );
273        try {
274            final Attachment att = mgr.getAttachmentInfo( attachmentName, version );
275            //FIXME: Find out why sometimes att is null
276            if( att != null ) {
277                return getAttachmentContent( att );
278            }
279        } catch( final ProviderException e ) {
280            LOG.error( "Attachment cannot be loaded", e );
281        }
282        return null;
283    }
284
285    /**
286     * @param att Attachment to get content for. Filename extension is used to determine the type of the attachment.
287     * @return String representing the content of the file.
288     * FIXME This is a very simple implementation of some text-based attachment, mainly used for testing.
289     * This should be replaced /moved to Attachment search providers or some other 'pluggable' way to search attachments
290     */
291    protected String getAttachmentContent( final Attachment att ) {
292        final AttachmentManager mgr = m_engine.getManager( AttachmentManager.class );
293        //FIXME: Add attachment plugin structure
294
295        final String filename = att.getFileName();
296
297        boolean searchSuffix = Arrays.stream(SEARCHABLE_FILE_SUFFIXES).anyMatch(filename::endsWith);
298
299        String out = filename;
300        if( searchSuffix ) {
301            try( final InputStream attStream = mgr.getAttachmentStream( att ); final StringWriter sout = new StringWriter() ) {
302                FileUtil.copyContents( new InputStreamReader( attStream ), sout );
303                out = out + " " + sout;
304            } catch( final ProviderException | IOException e ) {
305                LOG.error( "Attachment cannot be loaded", e );
306            }
307        }
308
309        return out;
310    }

312    /**
313     * Updates the lucene index for a single page.
314     *
315     * @param page The WikiPage to check
316     * @param text The page text to index.
317     */
318    protected synchronized void updateLuceneIndex( final Page page, final String text ) {
319        LOG.debug( "Updating Lucene index for page '{}'...", page.getName() );
320        pageRemoved( page );
321
322        // Now add back the new version.
323        try( final Directory luceneDir = new NIOFSDirectory( new File( m_luceneDirectory ).toPath() );
324             final IndexWriter writer = getIndexWriter( luceneDir ) ) {
325            luceneIndexPage( page, text, writer );
326        } catch( final IOException e ) {
327            LOG.error( "Unable to update page '{}' from Lucene index", page.getName(), e );
328            // reindexPage( page );
329        } catch( final Exception e ) {
330            LOG.error( "Unexpected Lucene exception - please check configuration!", e );
331            // reindexPage( page );
332        }
333
334        LOG.debug( "Done updating Lucene index for page '{}'.", page.getName() );
335    }

337    private Analyzer getLuceneAnalyzer() throws ProviderException {
338        try {
339            return ClassUtil.buildInstance( m_analyzerClass );
340        } catch( final Exception e ) {
341            final String msg = "Could not get LuceneAnalyzer class " + m_analyzerClass + ", reason: ";
342            LOG.error( msg, e );
343            throw new ProviderException( msg + e );
344        }
345    }
346
347    /**
348     * Indexes page using the given IndexWriter.
349     *
350     * @param page   WikiPage
351     * @param text   Page text to index
352     * @param writer The Lucene IndexWriter to use for indexing
353     * @return the created index Document
354     * @throws IOException If there's an indexing problem
355     */
356    protected Document luceneIndexPage( final Page page, final String text, final IndexWriter writer ) throws IOException {
357        LOG.debug( "Indexing {}...", page.getName() );
358
359        // make a new, empty document
360        final Document doc = new Document();
361        if( text == null ) {
362            return doc;
363        }
364
365        final String indexedText = text.replace( "__", " " ); // be nice to Language Analyzers - cfr. JSPWIKI-893
366
367        // Raw name is the keyword we'll use to refer to this document for updates.
368        Field field = new Field( LUCENE_ID, page.getName(), StringField.TYPE_STORED );
369        doc.add( field );
370
371        // Body text.  It is stored in the doc for search contexts.
372        field = new Field( LUCENE_PAGE_CONTENTS, indexedText, TextField.TYPE_STORED );
373        doc.add( field );
374
375        // Allow searching by page name. Both beautified and raw
376        final String unTokenizedTitle = StringUtils.replaceChars( page.getName(), TextUtil.PUNCTUATION_CHARS_ALLOWED, PUNCTUATION_TO_SPACES );
377        field = new Field( LUCENE_PAGE_NAME, TextUtil.beautifyString( page.getName() ) + " " + unTokenizedTitle, TextField.TYPE_STORED );
378        doc.add( field );
379
380        // Allow searching by authorname
381        if( page.getAuthor() != null ) {
382            field = new Field( LUCENE_AUTHOR, page.getAuthor(), TextField.TYPE_STORED );
383            doc.add( field );
384        }
385
386        // Now add the names of the attachments of this page
387        try {
388            final List< Attachment > attachments = m_engine.getManager( AttachmentManager.class ).listAttachments( page );
389            final String attachmentNames = attachments.stream().map(att -> att.getName() + ";").collect(Collectors.joining());
390
391            field = new Field( LUCENE_ATTACHMENTS, attachmentNames, TextField.TYPE_STORED );
392            doc.add( field );
393
394        } catch( final ProviderException e ) {
395            // Unable to read attachments
396            LOG.error( "Failed to get attachments for page", e );
397        }
398
399        // also index page keywords, if available
400        if( page.getAttribute( "keywords" ) != null ) {
401            field = new Field( LUCENE_PAGE_KEYWORDS, page.getAttribute( "keywords" ).toString(), TextField.TYPE_STORED );
402            doc.add( field );
403        }
404        synchronized( writer ) {
405            writer.addDocument( doc );
406        }
407
408        return doc;
409    }
410
411    /**
412     * {@inheritDoc}
413     */
414    @Override
415    public synchronized void pageRemoved( final Page page ) {
416        try( final Directory luceneDir = new NIOFSDirectory( new File( m_luceneDirectory ).toPath() );
417             final IndexWriter writer = getIndexWriter( luceneDir ) ) {
418            final Query query = new TermQuery( new Term( LUCENE_ID, page.getName() ) );
419            writer.deleteDocuments( query );
420        } catch( final Exception e ) {
421            LOG.error( "Unable to remove page '{}' from Lucene index", page.getName(), e );
422        }
423    }
424
425    IndexWriter getIndexWriter( final Directory luceneDir ) throws IOException, ProviderException {
426        final IndexWriterConfig writerConfig = new IndexWriterConfig( getLuceneAnalyzer() );
427        writerConfig.setOpenMode( OpenMode.CREATE_OR_APPEND );
428        return new IndexWriter( luceneDir, writerConfig );
429    }
430
431    /**
432     * Adds a page-text pair to the lucene update queue.  Safe to call always
433     *
434     * @param page WikiPage to add to the update queue.
435     */
436    @Override
437    public void reindexPage( final Page page ) {
438        if( page != null ) {
439            final String text;
440
441            // TODO: Think if this was better done in the thread itself?
442            if( page instanceof Attachment ) {
443                text = getAttachmentContent( ( Attachment ) page );
444            } else {
445                text = m_engine.getManager( PageManager.class ).getPureText( page );
446            }
447
448            if( text != null ) {
449                // Add work item to m_updates queue.
450                final Object[] pair = new Object[ 2 ];
451                pair[ 0 ] = page;
452                pair[ 1 ] = text;
453                m_updates.add( pair );
454                LOG.debug( "Scheduling page {} for index update", page.getName() );
455            }
456        }
457    }

459    /** {@inheritDoc} */
460    @Override
461    public Collection< SearchResult > findPages( final String query, final Context wikiContext ) throws ProviderException {
462        return findPages( query, FLAG_CONTEXTS, wikiContext );
463    }
464
465    /** Create contexts also. Generating contexts can be expensive, so they're not on by default. */
466    public static final int FLAG_CONTEXTS = 0x01;
467
468    /**
469     * Searches pages using a particular combination of flags.
470     *
471     * @param query The query to perform in Lucene query language
472     * @param flags A set of flags
473     * @return A Collection of SearchResult instances
474     * @throws ProviderException if there is a problem with the backend
475     */
476    public Collection< SearchResult > findPages( final String query, final int flags, final Context wikiContext ) throws ProviderException {
477        ArrayList< SearchResult > list = null;
478        Highlighter highlighter = null;
479
480        try( final Directory luceneDir = new NIOFSDirectory( new File( m_luceneDirectory ).toPath() );
481             final IndexReader reader = DirectoryReader.open( luceneDir ) ) {
482            final String[] queryfields = { LUCENE_PAGE_CONTENTS, LUCENE_PAGE_NAME, LUCENE_AUTHOR, LUCENE_ATTACHMENTS, LUCENE_PAGE_KEYWORDS };
483            final QueryParser qp = new SeparatorAwareQueryParser( queryfields, getLuceneAnalyzer() );
484            final Query luceneQuery = qp.parse( query );
485            final IndexSearcher searcher = new IndexSearcher( reader, searchExecutor );
486
487            if( ( flags & FLAG_CONTEXTS ) != 0 ) {
488                highlighter = new Highlighter( new SimpleHTMLFormatter( "<span class=\"searchmatch\">", "</span>" ),
489                                               new SimpleHTMLEncoder(),
490                                               new QueryScorer( luceneQuery ) );
491            }
492
493            final AuthorizationManager mgr = m_engine.getManager( AuthorizationManager.class );
494            final TopDocs hits = searcher.search( luceneQuery, MAX_SEARCH_HITS );
495            final StoredFields storedFields = reader.storedFields();
496
497            list = new ArrayList<>( hits.scoreDocs.length );
498            for( final ScoreDoc hit : hits.scoreDocs ) {
499                final Document doc = storedFields.document( hit.doc );
500                final String pageName = doc.get( LUCENE_ID );
501                final Page page = m_engine.getManager( PageManager.class ).getPage( pageName, PageProvider.LATEST_VERSION );
502
503                if( page != null ) {
504                    final PagePermission pp = new PagePermission( page, PagePermission.VIEW_ACTION );
505                    if( mgr.checkPermission( wikiContext.getWikiSession(), pp ) ) {
506                        final int score = ( int ) ( hit.score * 100 );
507
508                        // Get highlighted search contexts
509                        final String text = doc.get( LUCENE_PAGE_CONTENTS );
510
511                        String[] fragments = new String[ 0 ];
512                        if( text != null && highlighter != null ) {
513                            final TokenStream tokenStream = getLuceneAnalyzer().tokenStream( LUCENE_PAGE_CONTENTS, new StringReader( text ) );
514                            fragments = highlighter.getBestFragments( tokenStream, text, MAX_FRAGMENTS );
515                        }
516
517                        final SearchResult result = new SearchResultImpl( page, score, fragments );
518                        list.add( result );
519                    }
520                } else {
521                    LOG.error( "Lucene found a result page '{}' that could not be loaded, removing from Lucene cache",  pageName );
522                    pageRemoved( Wiki.contents().page( m_engine, pageName ) );
523                }
524            }
525        } catch( final IOException e ) {
526            LOG.error( "Failed during lucene search", e );
527        } catch( final ParseException e ) {
528            LOG.error( "Broken query; cannot parse query: {}", query, e );
529            throw new ProviderException( "You have entered a query Lucene cannot process [" + query + "]: " + e.getMessage() );
530        } catch( final InvalidTokenOffsetsException e ) {
531            LOG.error( "Tokens are incompatible with provided text ", e );
532        }
533
534        return list;
535    }

543    /**
544     * Updater thread that updates Lucene indexes.
545     */
546    private static final class LuceneUpdater extends WikiBackgroundThread {
547        static final int INDEX_DELAY    = 5;
548        static final int INITIAL_DELAY = 60;
549        private final LuceneSearchProvider m_provider;
550
551        private final int m_initialDelay;
552
553        private WatchDog m_watchdog;
554
555        private LuceneUpdater( final Engine engine, final LuceneSearchProvider provider, final int initialDelay, final int indexDelay ) {
556            super( engine, indexDelay );
557            m_provider = provider;
558            m_initialDelay = initialDelay;
559            setName( "JSPWiki Lucene Indexer" );
560        }
561
562        @Override
563        public void startupTask() throws Exception {
564            m_watchdog = WatchDog.getCurrentWatchDog( getEngine() );
565
566            // Sleep initially...
567            try {
568                Thread.sleep( m_initialDelay * 1000L );
569            } catch( final InterruptedException e ) {
570                throw new InternalWikiException( "Interrupted while waiting to start.", e );
571            }
572
573            m_watchdog.enterState( "Full reindex" );
574            // Reindex everything
575            m_provider.doFullLuceneReindex();
576            m_watchdog.exitState();
577        }
578
579        @Override
580        public void backgroundTask() {
581            m_watchdog.enterState( "Emptying index queue", 60 );
582
583            synchronized( m_provider.m_updates ) {
584                while(!m_provider.m_updates.isEmpty()) {
585                    final Object[] pair = m_provider.m_updates.remove( 0 );
586                    final Page page = ( Page )pair[ 0 ];
587                    final String text = ( String )pair[ 1 ];
588                    m_provider.updateLuceneIndex( page, text );
589                }
590            }
591
592            m_watchdog.exitState();
593        }
594
595    }
596
597    /**
598     * Query parser that lets wildcard terms cross the separators the analyzer splits on. The index holds {@code snake} and {@code case}
599     * for {@code snake_case}, so a term like {@code snake_ca*} would never find it. Such a term is split on the same separators and
600     * matched as adjacent tokens instead, with the wildcard applied to the token it is in. A trailing separator, as in
601     * {@code snake_*}, only requires the tokens before it.
602     */
603    static final class SeparatorAwareQueryParser extends MultiFieldQueryParser {
604
605        private static final String NON_SEPARATORS = "[\\p{L}\\p{N}*?]*";
606        private static final String SEPARATORS = "[^\\p{L}\\p{N}*?]+";
607
608        SeparatorAwareQueryParser( final String[] fields, final Analyzer analyzer ) {
609            super( fields, analyzer );
610        }
611
612        @Override
613        protected Query getPrefixQuery( final String field, final String termStr ) throws ParseException {
614            final Query separated = field != null ? separated( field, termStr, true ) : null;
615            if( separated == null ) {
616                return super.getPrefixQuery( field, termStr );
617            }
618            try {
619                return either( super.getPrefixQuery( field, termStr ), separated );
620            } catch( final ParseException e ) {
621                return separated; // the default handling does not accept the term, the separated one does
622            }
623        }
624
625        @Override
626        protected Query getWildcardQuery( final String field, final String termStr ) throws ParseException {
627            final Query separated = field != null ? separated( field, termStr, false ) : null;
628            if( separated == null ) {
629                return super.getWildcardQuery( field, termStr );
630            }
631            try {
632                return either( super.getWildcardQuery( field, termStr ), separated );
633            } catch( final ParseException e ) {
634                return separated; // the default handling does not accept the term, the separated one does
635            }
636        }
637
638        /**
639         * Matches what either query matches. The default query is kept because the analyzer does not always split on a separator, so
640         * a token like {@code blogentry_021126_1} can hold it and only the default query finds it.
641         */
642        private static Query either( final Query defaultQuery, final Query separated ) {
643            return new BooleanQuery.Builder()
644                    .add( defaultQuery, BooleanClause.Occur.SHOULD )
645                    .add( separated, BooleanClause.Occur.SHOULD )
646                    .build();
647        }
648
649        /**
650         * Builds the query for a term that holds separators, or returns {@code null} if the default handling applies.
651         *
652         * @param prefix {@code true} if the term is a prefix whose trailing {@code *} has already been removed
653         */
654        private Query separated( final String field, final String termStr, final boolean prefix ) throws ParseException {
655            if( termStr.matches( NON_SEPARATORS ) ) {
656                return null;
657            }
658
659            final boolean endsWithSeparator = termStr.matches( ".*" + SEPARATORS );
660            final List< SpanQuery > clauses = new ArrayList<>();
661            final String[] segments = Arrays.stream( termStr.split( SEPARATORS ) ).filter( segment -> !segment.isEmpty() ).toArray( String[]::new );
662            for( int i = 0; i < segments.length; i++ ) {
663                final String segment = segments[ i ];
664                if( segment.indexOf( '*' ) != -1 || segment.indexOf( '?' ) != -1 ) {
665                    final Term term = new Term( field, getAnalyzer().normalize( field, segment ) );
666                    clauses.add( new SpanMultiTermQueryWrapper<>( new WildcardQuery( term ) ) );
667                } else if( prefix && i == segments.length - 1 && !endsWithSeparator ) {
668                    final Term term = new Term( field, getAnalyzer().normalize( field, segment ) );
669                    clauses.add( new SpanMultiTermQueryWrapper<>( new PrefixQuery( term ) ) );
670                } else {
671                    for( final String token : tokens( field, segment ) ) {
672                        clauses.add( new SpanTermQuery( new Term( field, token ) ) );
673                    }
674                }
675            }
676
677            if( clauses.isEmpty() ) {
678                return null;
679            }
680            return clauses.size() == 1 ? clauses.get( 0 ) : new SpanNearQuery( clauses.toArray( new SpanQuery[ 0 ] ), 0, true );
681        }
682
683        private List< String > tokens( final String field, final String text ) throws ParseException {
684            final List< String > tokens = new ArrayList<>();
685            try( final TokenStream stream = getAnalyzer().tokenStream( field, text ) ) {
686                final CharTermAttribute term = stream.addAttribute( CharTermAttribute.class );
687                stream.reset();
688                while( stream.incrementToken() ) {
689                    tokens.add( term.toString() );
690                }
691                stream.end();
692            } catch( final IOException e ) {
693                throw new ParseException( "Cannot analyze '" + text + "': " + e.getMessage() );
694            }
695            return tokens;
696        }
697
698    }

700    // FIXME: This class is dumb; needs to have a better implementation
701    private static class SearchResultImpl implements SearchResult {
702
703        private final Page m_page;
704        private final int m_score;
705        private final String[] m_contexts;
706
707        public SearchResultImpl( final Page page, final int score, final String[] contexts ) {
708            m_page = page;
709            m_score = score;
710            m_contexts = contexts != null ? contexts.clone() : null;
711        }
712
713        @Override
714        public Page getPage() {
715            return m_page;
716        }
717
718        /* (non-Javadoc)
719         * @see org.apache.wiki.SearchResult#getScore()
720         */
721        @Override
722        public int getScore() {
723            return m_score;
724        }
725
726
727        @Override
728        public String[] getContexts() {
729            return m_contexts;
730        }
731    }
